method: Full rendered table, 734 droppable rows; remove 49 chests and 1 currency; separate 10 special collectibles. Medians average the two middle observations for even sample sizes. Use base price, not live exchange price.
caveats: Unweighted catalogue statistics, not map drop statistics
Currency scale, appraisal adjustments and area exponent are our adaptation
Special small treasures may cost more than large ordinary items
